scope: Static PNG/JPEG/WebP images and supported mono/stereo audio. Recipes use bundled codecs; video, resizing and surround are outside this application.
requiredContext: output destination within granted folders when export is requested
compression goal and whether lossy copies are allowed

defaults.unresolvedQualityGoal: Ask once about exact preservation versus visually similar/listening-approved lossy copies; reuse existing answers. If the user delegates without authorizing loss, use lossless.
defaults.originals: Never overwrite; retain dimensions/channels and rendering-critical properties. A smaller result is not guaranteed.
defaults.return: Give the exported images/audio or usable paths, original/output bytes, savings, actual settings and material notices/errors. Use exports[].path from this export call; historical candidate.exported filenames are relative and may belong to earlier destinations. Show exact preservation only when verified. Do not stop with a plan.

studyMcp: import_media for requested inputs only; paginate list_media if needed
Choose an applicable variant and filter/validate its settings against actual properties; plan_study exposes invalid settings and sample-rate conversions
Disclose required conversions before starting; do not silently change precision, transparency, rate or channels
start_study with imported mediaId/settings; poll returned job IDs until ready/failed/canceled
get_candidates; inspect errors and apply recipe selection to real outputs
export_candidates with chosen candidateIds and granted destination when export was authorized
studyCli: Use full executable paths and argument arrays; read capabilities, tools and recipes
inspect requested inputs; choose applicable settings using actual properties and codec limits
Write request JSON {paths:[absolute input paths],settings:[chosen encoder settings]}; study --input request.json --manifest new-study.json --root granted-folder waits internally
Read real candidates/errors; export --input export.json --root granted-folder with {study:manifest path,candidateIds:[chosen IDs],destination:absolute output folder,report:false}
Use new request/manifest names for refinements; verified cache avoids duplicate encodes; disclose partial failures and verify export outcomes
Keep control JSON/manifests in a task-owned temporary directory within grants; remove only those task-created control files after export unless the user wants the study saved
workflows.folderCli: compress-folder <folder> --mode lossless|smaller|both --destination <output-parent> --root <granted-folder>; waits and returns output paths

recipes.goal: Make a smaller copy with exactly unchanged decoded pixels
recipes.selection: Try supported alternatives; require a lossless producing setting and pixelIdentical=true, unchanged dimensions/precision and rendering-critical properties. Export the smallest tested valid output below original bytes. If none is smaller, return the original path and reason.
recipes.notes: High precision and gray ICC sources permit lossless PNG optimization only when the source is PNG. SSIM=1 alone is insufficient. Compressed copies can remove private metadata.

recipes.goal: Make a smaller image quickly; lossy copies are allowed
recipes.selection: Export the valid preset if it is smaller; otherwise return the original and reason. This is a single-preset operation, not a quality study or invisible-loss guarantee.

recipes.goal: Recommend a visually similar smaller image using real measurements; lossy copies are allowed
recipes.selection: Compare bytes, both SSIM composites, alpha errors and notices. Prefer a lossless candidate when it is at least as small as a suitable lossy candidate. Refine only where warranted. Use user requirements/inspection to recommend a tradeoff; no universal SSIM threshold proves invisibility. Export when already authorized to choose; otherwise present alternatives for requested review.
recipes.notes: Preserve alpha. Quality is an encoder control. MCP previews are thumbnails, not full-resolution inspection. Missing SSIM is unavailable evidence.

recipes.goal: Use a requested PNG/JPEG/WebP output format
recipes.selection: Respect the requested format and preservation requirements. Ask for an explicit #RRGGBB background before adding background to JPEG settings for transparent input. Export a larger valid output only when the format requirement/deliberate choice warrants it and disclose its size.
recipes.notes: No lossless JPEG encoder is provided. PNG lossy palette studies are available through custom settings. Reject unsupported precision rather than silently reducing it.

recipes.goal: Make a smaller audio copy with exactly unchanged decoded samples
recipes.selection: Require lossless settings, samplesIdentical=true and unchanged sample rate, channels/layout and supported precision. Export the smallest tested valid output below original bytes, otherwise return the original and reason.
recipes.notes: Inspect bit depth and sample format before using FLAC. Float/unsupported precision cannot be silently converted for an exact claim. Converting MP3/AAC to FLAC cannot recover discarded information.

recipes.goal: Make a smaller audio copy quickly; lossy copies are allowed
recipes.selection: Use the applicable channel variant, preserving a supported source rate. Disclose required rate conversion before encoding; choose a rate-preserving supported alternative if conversion was not authorized. Export only when smaller, otherwise return the original and reason.
recipes.notes: AAC-LC produces M4A. Check duration/timing/notices; do not claim inaudibility from bitrate or timing. No normalization, trimming or channel mixing.

recipes.goal: Compare measured sizes and listen to audio candidates; lossy copies are allowed
recipes.defaultFormat: aac when it preserves the source rate; choose a supported alternative or disclose any required conversion
recipes.selection: Inspect actual bytes, source/output properties, durationDelta and notices; reject unexplained truncation. Use the user's listening feedback to choose acceptable tradeoffs. If delegated to choose and export without listening, deliver a conservative recommendation qualified as unverified perceptual quality, not inaudible. Do not invent an audio similarity score.
recipes.notes: Opus processes at 48 kHz; disclose before processing other rates. MP3 VBR lower numbers mean higher quality. Listening comparison in the GUI uses a shared timeline/volume; agent studies do not automatically populate the GUI.

recipes.goal: Use user-specified format, quality/bitrate/VBR levels or effort
recipes.selection: Build settings from the supplied values and actual codec capabilities. Accept the full supported range without a perceptual floor; validate combinations and preflight work. Respect requested selection/export policy, including deliberate aggressive or larger outputs. Ask only for missing consequential choices; reuse known answers.
recipes.notes: Each media item accepts 1–512 settings, with bounded workers and cancellation. Quality/bitrate values cannot predict exact output size. Separate CLI requests for different media kinds/settings; MCP supports per-file settings.

recipes.goal: Try to fit an explicit maximum file size within the user's quality/format constraints
recipes.selection: Start from an applicable measured-image or audio-study recipe, compare actual bytes to the user's byte budget and refine a bounded set of supported levels. Do not assume monotonic size or a globally optimal binary search. Apply only user-supplied quality constraints. Export a valid within-budget recommendation when authorized; otherwise explain the unmet budget and useful alternatives without silently overriding constraints.
recipes.notes: Resizing, trimming and channel mixing are outside these recipes. A budget can be impossible at preserved dimensions/channels. SSIM targets remain diagnostic targets; audio needs listening for perceptual judgments.

recipes.goal: Compress a folder with no per-file agent orchestration
recipes.selection: Default lossless unless lossy copies are authorized. Smaller uses the documented preset; Both makes Lossless and Smaller folders and prefers a verified lossless output in Smaller when it saves at least as much. Run one folder command, wait, and return actual output paths/totals/errors.
recipes.notes: Copies originals if a preset is unsupported or would enlarge the file. Skips generated folders/cache/links and preserves nested paths. Disclose copied originals and partial failures. Use custom studies only when requested.
